relevance_note: Case report of one in-scope patient with SSADH deficiency (ALDH5A1 variants): "We report on a patient with SSADH deficiency in whom we found low levels of blood reduced glutathione (GSH)".
method_note: No tables in this paper; every value was read from the running text (no script transcribed any table). One in-scope person: the single patient of this case report, labelled 'patient' (rule 5; the paper gives her no label of her own, and 'the patient'/'our patient' are role words). The paper's own clinical/genetic report of this person, not a summary of an earlier report, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' (the two earlier reports cited for the variants are references for the variants, not for this patient). The source Markdown uses non-breaking spaces between many numbers and units (e.g. '1.5 months', '150 mg/kg/d', 'age 10 months', '900 μM ± 140'); spans are written with \u00a0 so they match it character for character. Uncertainties: (1) the EEG description ('high amplitude delta activity with frequent bursts of sharpened alpha/beta range activity') is not explicitly called abnormal, yet I scored 'EEG abnormality (background slowing or epileptiform activity)' as observed and recorded the EEG text as a phenotypic feature; (2) 'Brain MRI at age 4 months was normal and has not been repeated.' names no specific abnormality, so under D-27 I excluded only the general phenotypic row 'abnormal brain MRI' and left both MRI checklist items (T2 hyperintensity of the deep nuclei; cerebral or cerebellar atrophy) as 'not reported'; (3) 'Biparental inheritance was confirmed.' does not say which parent carries which variant, so both variants are 'inherited unspecified parent'; (4) the paper never gives an age at diagnosis or the diagnostic age of the urine organic acids, so age_at_diagnosis is 'not reported' while age_at_onset is the 1.5 months stiffening episodes; (5) vital status is not stated ('not reported'), although she was alive and 10 months old at the last evaluation; (6) the sentence 'she continued to have severe diffuse' is printed without a noun, and I used it only as a severity qualifier for hypotonia; (7) no contradiction found inside the paper (the exaggerated Moro response disappearing by age 4 months is a change over time, not a contradiction). No stacked cells (' / ') occur in this paper.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: urine organic acids consistent with the diagnosis of SSADH deficiency, plus sequencing of ALDH5A1 showing two heterozygous variants
span: Urine organic acids showed a marked elevation of 4-hydroxybutyric acid (GHB) as well as abnormal elevations of 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid lactones, glycolic, 3-hydroxypropionic, glutaric, adipic, and 2-hydroxyglutaric acids consistent with the diagnosis of SSADH deficiency.
Sequencing of ALDH5A1 revealed a heterozygous splice site variant c.610-612A>G (IVS3-2A>G) in intron 3, and a heterozygous missense mutation c.1333A>C (p.M445L) in exon 9.
